data.name: Ismaael
data.long_meaning:
God heard and answered our prayer.
Ismaael is the name of Ibrahim's (Abraham) son, born in response to God's promise that Ibrahim would father a son in his old age. When Ibrahim was about to sacrifice his son Ismaael as a test of his faith, God intervened and provided a ram as a substitute.
Ismaael is also known as Ishmael.
data.spiritual_meaning: A test of faith and obedience to God.
data.numerology_meaning: Those with the name Ismaael are creative, passionate, and adaptable. They are known for their strong will and determination.

in_arabic.name: إسماعيل
in_arabic.long_meaning: إسماعيل هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه: الله يسمع و يستجيب الدعاء، و هو من الأسماء التي ذكرت في القرآن الكريم، و هو اسم سيدنا إسماعيل عليه السلام، ابن سيدنا إبراهيم عليه السلام، و يعتبر إسماعيل من الأسماء ذات الأهمية الكبيرة في الإسلام

in_urdu.name: اسماعیل
in_urdu.meaning: اللہ سنتا ہے اور دعا قبول کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: اسماعیل ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے اللہ سنتا ہے اور دعا قبول کرتا ہے، یہ نام قرآن مجید میں ذکر ہوا ہے، اور یہ سیدنا اسماعیل عليه السلام کا نام ہے، جو سیدنا ابراہیم عليه السلام کے بیٹے تھے، اسماعیل نام اسلامی تقليد میں بہت اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے

In Islamic tradition, Ismaael is considered a significant name due to its association with the prophets and its etymological connection to divine communication.

data.cultural_impact: Ismaael is a significant figure in Islamic history, as he is considered the ancestor of the Arab people through his son, Predjad. He is revered for his patience, obedience, and devotion to his father, especially during the trial of the Akedah (sacrifice) when Ibrahim was tested to sacrifice him.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Ismaael carries a deep spiritual meaning as it symbolizes God's promise to answer the prayers of His faithful servants. It highlights the importance of faith, obedience, and sacrifice, and serves as a reminder that even in times of hardship and adversity, God is always present and listening. It also represents God's mercy and compassion, as He protected Ismaael from being sacrificed and provided a substitute instead.
